Ph.D. in Biomedical Sciences
The Ph.D. in Biomedical Sciences is geared toward motivated students who want to build on a strong foundation in research and prepare for a successful career in academia, research, health care, or the biotechnology industry. As a graduate student in biomedical sciences at CSU, you’ll join a dynamic and impactful scientific community, working alongside One Health-focused faculty at one of the country’s top veterinary colleges.

about the department
Biomedical Sciences
The Department of Biomedical Sciences offers undergraduate through postdoctoral education guided by dedicated faculty who pursue translational research in the disciplines of anatomy, neurobiology, pharmacology, physiology, and reproductive biology. More than 30 specialty laboratories allow students to gain hands-on learning experiences tailored to individualized interests and goals in human and animal health and disease.
Program Highlights
Lab rotations and individualized research tailored to your career interests
Small cohort size
Flexible course options
Strong support network of graduate mentors and advisors
Opportunities to teach, participate in training grants and formally present research
Research Opportunities
Lab rotations with our world-renowned, award-winning faculty span from the molecular and cellular level to large animal and translational research in the following core research areas:
Cardiovascular physiology
Neurobiology
Reproductive biology
Training grants
Students may be eligible to earn grant funding and additional hands-on research experience by participating in a research training opportunity funded by the National Institutes of Health:
Initiative for Maximizing Student Development in Translational Medicine Program
Infectious Disease Research and Response Training Program

Application Information and Deadlines
This program starts only in the fall.
Admission requirements:
Minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale
Official transcripts (unofficial transcripts can be uploaded for review, but official transcripts will be required for admission)
Resume or curriculum vitae (CV)
Personal statement
3 letters of recommendation
Application fee; the Graduate School offers application fee waivers to participants in specific, eligible programs. Learn how to apply for free.
To apply, complete the Online Graduate Application via the Graduate School portal. The application deadline is Dec. 1. Only completed applications submitted by this date will be reviewed. Late applications will not be considered. Please contact [email protected] for questions.
Select candidates will be invited for interview rounds with final selections made by March 7.
